'''Cold Water''' is a leader of a pack of wolves.

==Activities==
Cold Water, along with [[Three Toes]], [[Twilight (wolf)|Twilight]] and [[Springhorn]] are contacted by [[Perrin Aybara]] in his search for his wife, [[Faile Bashere]]. They are unable to help.{{ref/book|9|2}}
